stories.title: Could Nvidia survive without its ultra-powerful CEO, Jensen Huang?
stories.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has helmed the company since starting it in 1993, guiding it from a graphics card maker to the AI behemoth it is today. But with an investigation now underway into whether Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort and no clear successor in sight, analysts say a change at the top — if it were deemed necessary — would be massive.
